purpose: HSPICE W element, two coupled lossy conductors, against ngspice CPL

oracle.derivation: ngspice -n -b -r cpl.raw on tran/device_coupled_tlines.sp (P card, CPL model with the same R, L, C); samples at ngspice's accepted times. CPL and the W fit both approximate the line; the tolerance (2.5e-2 V) covers edge timing.
